name: TextRemover.video
summary: Erases on-screen text from a video and restores the background, with signup credits, monthly plans and one-time packs.
description: TextRemover.video removes text from videos and rebuilds the background rather than blurring it. Official pricing: new accounts get 30 free processing seconds on signup (valid 30 days, no card, once per account; up to two new accounts per signup network each month). Credits are one per second of video, with the cost shown before you start. Free and subscription credits are spent before pack credits.

pricing.details: 30 free seconds on signup (valid 30 days, no card, once per account). Starter 22 €/month (600 seconds); Pro 67 €/month (2,000 seconds). Unused subscription credits expire at the next monthly reset. One-time packs that do not expire: 4 € (100 s), 20 € (500 s), 49 € (1,200 s). Uploads are MP4 or MOV, 60 seconds maximum.
pricing.label: Freemium
